102
Identify the correct set of statements : (a) The leaflets are modified into pointed hard thorns in Citrus
and Bougainvillea (b) Axillary buds form slender and spirally coiled tendrils in cucumber and pumpkin
(c) Stem is flattened and fleshy in Opuntia and modified to perform the function of leaves (d)
Rhizophora shows vertically upward growing roots that help to get oxygen for respiration (e)
Subaerially growing stems in grasses and strawberry help in vegetative propagation Choose the
correct answer from the options given below :
(1)
(b) and (c) Only
(2)
(a) and (d) Only
(3)
(b), (c), (d) and (e) Only
(4)
(a), (b), (d) and (e) Only
Plant Kingdom
subject: Biology
b6_reason: (b), (c), (d) and (e) are all correct; (a) is wrong because the thorns of Citrus and Bougainvillea are modified axillary buds, not leaflets.
b6_working: a: thorns in Citrus/Bougainvillea arise from axillary buds (stem modification) -> false. b: stem tendrils from axillary buds in cucumber and pumpkin, slender and spirally coiled -> true. c: Opuntia has flattened fleshy photosynthetic stem (phylloclade) doing the leaf's job -> true. d: Rhizophora pneumatophores grow vertically up out of the mud for gas exchange -> true. e: subaerial runners of grasses and strawberry propagate vegetatively -> true. Correct set = b, c, d, e.
b6_note: Statement (a) is the single distractor; it mirrors the real NCERT line but swaps leaflets for axillary buds.
